subject: POC: sandbox/top-up request after connector QA failure
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@fathompay.com>

Cc: dev-team@fathompay.com
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - SSO connector failing in QA (need runway)

Hi Kimberly,

Quick update from our side — the SSO connector started failing during our automated QA runs yesterday. Our engineers are blocked on an intermittent token validation error when we hit sequence lengths >1024 tokens; it looks like a header-parsing edge case when the test harness runs parallel auth flows.

We spun up additional logs and attached a short excerpt (fathompay_integration_log_excerpt.txt). Unfortunately this has pushed our POC timeline out by at least two sprints. The product team wants to keep momentum but we need extra sandbox capacity to continue testing once the fix lands.

Could Redwood approve a two-week extension on our trial window and a sandbox top-up (~$2.5k of credits) so we can re-run the full test matrix? Without this runway the internal stakeholders will pause the POC and escalate procurement priorities elsewhere.

We appreciate any help. Happy to jump on a quick sync with your CS/engineering team — mornings PST are best for us.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director of Engineering, FathomPay

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the log snippet. Sorry to hear this hit at a critical moment.

I'm escalating to Sales and CS to fast-track a credit/top-up review. Ben and Marissa — looping you both for approval and to recommend the right amount.

Alyssa, can you paste the exact token error line and confirm whether this happens on a single environment or across all QA nodes? That will help our engineers triage before we schedule a sync. Also confirming: you need a two-week trial extension and ~$2.5k of sandbox credits, correct?

I'll do my best to move this same-day.

— Kimberly
